title: Trillion tokens, trillion parameters
gist: A stack tuned for one customer's coding-agent traffic: a draft model fine-tuned on the target model's own coding traces, an 8-bit KV cache, a CPU-memory cache tier, and session-affinity routing.
changes: Contains the cleanest tuned-against-generic number available: training the draft model on the customer's traces was worth about 20%. The post also says the same principles carried over to other customers and models.
caveats: The 2.8x and 5.6x headline figures are against an unoptimised replica that is not specified. Quality evaluation is described as still being built.

numbers.metric: Speculative accept length after fine-tuning the draft on workload traces
numbers.value: 5.00 to 5.84 tokens per step, about 20% faster

bears_on.note: Like for like, per-customer tuning was worth about 20%, and the recipe transferred to other customers.
The stack was designed around the shape of coding-agent traffic: 100k tokens in, 500 out.
